capabilities: :: Create visual blocks using fenced Markdown
extras: Requires Node.js 20.19 or newer and npm for installation from source. The plugin operates offline and has no telemetry.
problem: Standard Markdown lacks a native, easy-to-use way to create structured, styled, and reusable visual blocks like definitions or callouts.
summary: Advanced Markdown Blocks allows users to create, customize, and style visual blocks using fenced Markdown syntax, providing structured presentation for notes.
